Stock adjustment recalculates product.stock as sum of all warehouse stocks (converting dus to satuan)

POS.js main container uses 'h-screen overflow-hidden' to prevent body scroll
Reports.js exportPDF uses jsPDF with autoTable plugin - letterhead uses colors (15,23,42) dark slate and (37,99,235) blue accent
Reports.js marginPercent is defined after exportPDF function but works due to component re-render before function call
